scope.name: Frozen-source clean final build and machine-readable evidence
actions: Freeze source commit after WP0 through WP6 complete
Build application payload from an empty staging directory
Regenerate payload-files.json payload hashes release-manifest.json and release-manifest.sha256
Build final installer and generate external release-evidence.json
Reject reuse of any WP1 test manifest hash or evidence
Perform clean install and execute all ten Phase 1 acceptance checks
Regenerate final build identity offline startup build provenance and boot failure diagnostics evidence against the frozen-source final installer
Generate phase1 acceptance evidence that references only WP7 final-installer evidence and never WP1 WP3 or WP4 development evidence
exitCriteria: No old installer overlay mechanism is used
Final hashes and manifest are recomputed after source freeze
Installed tree contains no old runtime residue
All ten machine-readable evidence checks pass

hardGates.rule: WP7 production implementation is forbidden until WP7_ACTIVATION_ACCEPTED is independently signed.
No production code, required-test implementation, final build, installer build, or machine evidence execution before a separate WP7 Design Gate is completed after Activation acceptance.
Final sourceCommit must be frozen only after WP0 through WP6 are complete and must match all final release evidence.
Final release source and release manifest must bind the accepted runtime protocol version 3; otherwise Convergence Pre-Review cannot pass.
No WP1 test manifest, hash, or evidence may be reused in the final build.
Final verification must use CLEAN_INSTALL and must not require legacy test data migration or rollback to a legacy test version.
